title: 第29章  临川沈家灭门惨案
novel_title: 人在镇魔司，红词加身只杀不渡
content_zh:
司务堂。

    “陆大人，凭此符牌、印信可与临川县同僚交接换防事宜，请您务必收好。”

    “还有，您的官服也赶制好了，都在这里。”

    书吏老周将一只官囊放在柜面上。

    陆渊接过，打开看了一眼，将东西收好。

    老周的声音又在耳边响起。

    “陆大人，临川县近来妖魔频发，连老牌镇魔校尉赵衡都倍感压力，若事不可为，您千万别死撑。”

    “好嘞，知道了。”

    陆渊笑着应了一声，拱了拱手，转身往外走去。

    老周一边收拾柜面，一边目光盯着陆渊背影。

    他记的清清楚楚，入门那天，此人还只是凡境二层。

    这种修为，放在青州镇魔司连垫底都排不上。

    当时他还在心里叹了口气，此子今后怕是走不远了。

    可这才过了几天？

    除血妖，灭尸魔，斩长生教阎九渊，覆灭赤霞县分舵。

    直至刚才，那官囊中的印信符牌。

    老周活了大半辈子，可从来没听过如此不切实际的事。

    就算是茶楼话本里的传说故事，主角也得有个循序渐进的过程啊。

    先拜名师，再苦修数年，偶尔得一奇遇，还要经历生死磨炼。

    连天才都需要时间来成长，陆渊却不需要。

    就好像冥冥中有什么在推着他，一路摧枯拉朽冲破所有桎梏。

    老周在镇魔司数十载，见过庸才，见过天才，见过昙花一现或大器晚成。

    可像陆渊这样，昨天才刚抵达山脚，今天就已经站在山巅。

    不声不响站在了众人头顶，等大家再反应过来时，他已经走出去很远了，远到只留下一个模糊背影。

    老周回过神来，司务堂大门后面，陆渊的背影已经消失，连影子都看不见了。

    他静静看着陆渊的档案。

    入门记录，战力评定，差事履历，一笔一画清清楚楚，可他总觉得这些笔画根本写不出那个年轻人的万分之一。

    他提起笔，笔尖悬于纸面上方，停顿良久。

    惊才绝艳！
content_en:
Si Wu Hall.

    "Master Lu, with this talisman and seal, you can communicate with your colleagues in Linchuan County about the defense change. Please be sure to keep it."

    "Also, your official uniforms have also been made and they are all here."

    The scribe Lao Zhou placed an official pouch on the counter.

    Lu Yuan took it, opened it, took a look, and put the things away.

    Lao Zhou's voice rang in his ears again.

    "Sir Lu, demons have appeared frequently in Linchuan County recently. Even Zhao Heng, the veteran demon-suppressing school captain, is feeling the pressure. If something cannot be done, you must not hold on."

    "Okay, got it."

    Lu Yuan responded with a smile, cupped his hands, turned around and walked out.

    While Lao Zhou was cleaning up the counter, he stared at Lu Yuan's back.

    He remembered clearly that on the day he entered, this person was only on the second level of the mortal realm.

    With this level of cultivation, Qingzhou Demon Suppression Division wouldn't even rank at the bottom.

    At that time, he still sighed in his heart. He was afraid that he would not be able to go far from now on.

    But how many days has passed?

    Eliminate the blood demon, destroy the corpse demon, kill Yan Jiuyuan of the Immortality Sect, and destroy the Chixia County branch.

    Until just now, the seal talisman in the official bag.

    Lao Zhou has lived for most of his life, but he has never heard of such unrealistic things.

    Even if it is a legendary story in a teahouse storybook, the protagonist must go through a step-by-step process.

    You must first worship a famous teacher, then practice hard for several years, occasionally have a chance encounter, and then go through life and death.

    Even geniuses need time to grow, but Lu Yuan doesn't.

    It was as if something was pushing him, breaking through all the shackles along the way.

    Lao Zhou has been in the Demon Suppression Division for decades and has seen mediocre people, geniuses, short-lived talents or late bloomers.

    But people like Lu Yuan, who just arrived at the foot of the mountain yesterday, are already standing on the top of the mountain today.

    He stood silently above everyone's heads. When everyone reacted, he had already walked far away, so far away that only a blurry figure was left behind.

    When Lao Zhou came to his senses, Lu Yuan's back had disappeared behind the gate of the Siwu Hall, and even his shadow could not be seen.

    He looked at Lu Yuan's file quietly.

    Entry records, combat strength assessments, and errand resumes were clearly drawn one by one, but he always felt that these strokes could not describe one ten thousandth of that young man.

    He lifted the pen, the pen tip hanging above the paper, and paused for a long time.

    Stunningly talented!
title_en: Chapter 29 The massacre of the Shen family in Linchuan
